pullRequests.author: momo1212221
pullRequests.head: feat/multiplayer-pal-localization
pullRequests.body:
The multiplayer pages currently remain English when a PAL player selects another game language. This adds original UI translations for all five PAL languages: English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.

Select the language from the game's current language word (using verified PAL and NTSC-U addresses), with English fallback, and refresh page content and in-game notices when it changes.
Translate the home/browser/lobby/direct-connect/pause pages, local save picker, button hints,…

pullRequests.author: momo1212221
pullRequests.head: feat/multiplayer-comfort
pullRequests.body:
The existing co-op mod has no teammate rescue or shared gathering marker. This extends Multiplayer to 0.8.0 with a Team tools child page in the existing lobby and Multiplayer pause Options page, without consuming an additional native Options slot.

pullRequests.author: mateuszklysz
pullRequests.head: fix/kbm-circle-in-dialogs
pullRequests.body:
Before: creating save data (or formatting a card) asks in a freeze dialog (mode 4), where yes is Circle and no is Triangle (update_mode_freeze, states 6 and 13). In dialogs the mod gave Circle only to Backspace in the race dialog, so no key could create a save. Players worked around it by breaking the manifest (menu_Circle), which makes the mod refuse to load so the port's own E = Circle takes over.
After: Menu: Circle (E by default) presses Circle in every dialog too, so E creates the save and…

commits.headline: [WIP] feat(multiplayer): co-op round 3, crossplay, saves, takeover and mod codes (#22)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
* feat(multiplayer): keep the game's data within the server's rates

Everything went to the server as it came, one DATA per message: bolts, spawns
and breaks each a frame, the whole world one frame per moby for a new member.
Over 60 a second the server drops DATA and counts a strike, and closes the
connection after 20; state over its own 60 goes without a word.

Events now queue in order and leave through a bucket below the server's, those
for one target together as one BATCH, so a burst comes…

commits.headline: test(multiplayer): wait for the first datagrams, not only the binding
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
On a slow runner the state sent while UDP binds may still be in flight
when both sides say bound: keep sending until each side has one.

commits.headline: test(multiplayer): give the socket tests 15 s to settle
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
pump_until returns as soon as its condition holds, so only a slow
runner (Windows CI) waits longer; 3 s was short there.

commits.headline: fix(multiplayer): a direct host's END reaches its members
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The host closed its members' sockets with their frames unread, which
resets the connection (always on Windows) and drops the END the member
had not read yet. Shut the sending side first and read away what still
comes in until the member closes or the flush time is up.

commits.headline: test(multiplayer): raw reads wait for the frames they count
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A read that checks for N frames now stops once N are in and waits up to
ten times its time for them: 300 ms was too short on Windows CI.
